tiers.name: apple-adt
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDK (Foundation-only, Sources/) and AgenticDeveloperHubSDKUI (SourcesUI/), for macOS, iOS, watchOS, tvOS and visionOS. The bottom of the Apple stack: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKCore re-exports the Foundation framework, and the UI-bearing ATK frameworks link the UI one.

tiers.name: apple-hubclient
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubClient (Sources/: the full generated OpenAPI client and ADHSyncAPI) over AgenticDeveloperHubAuth (AuthSources/: ADHClient, the auth-only generated client, the session, Keychain stores and transports incl. EmbeddedDaemon), over swift-openapi-runtime/urlsession. AgenticDeveloperHubClient re-exports AgenticDeveloperHubAuth.

tiers.name: apple-avatar-engine
tiers.holds: AvatarAnimationEngine. The native avatar engine — scene, path, render, anim and runtime.

tiers.name: apple-sample-app
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSampleApp. A demo app per Apple platform. Wiring only.

tiers.name: apple-core
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKCore. Foundation only — no UI, no platform APIs.

tiers.name: apple-language
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKLanguage. The text-document model and the LSP client — Foundation, AgenticDeveloperHubSDKCore and the ChimeHQ JSONRPC/LanguageServerProtocol/LanguageClient stack. No AppKit, so it is daemon-safe; the AppKit face of a TextDocument is TextDocumentStorage one tier up in apple-macos. LanguageServerProtocol's Position/Range/TextEdit/Diagnostic vocabulary is the document model's vocabulary, which is why the two live in one framework rather than two.

tiers.name: apple-pluginkit
tiers.holds: AIPluginKit. The plugin ABI and loading model.

tiers.name: apple-coreui
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKCoreUI. Cross-cutting AppKit utilities and primitive views.

tiers.name: apple-coremacos
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKCoreMacOS. macOS-only foundations.

tiers.name: apple-permissions
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKPermissions. TCC/entitlement state, no UI.

tiers.name: apple-displays
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKDisplays. Display inventory, modes, anchor layouts, monitoring, thumbnails, Universal Control placement. System frameworks only - the displayr CLI links it alone.

tiers.name: apple-launch
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKLaunch. Startup-job protocols, StartupQueue and LaunchManager: first-run and install work done natively.

tiers.name: apple-launchui
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKLaunchUI. The AppKit presenter for LaunchManager: the undismissable progress panel and run-loop alerts.

tiers.name: apple-permissionsui
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKPermissionsUI. The permission-request surfaces.

tiers.name: apple-database
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKDatabase. Storage primitives.

tiers.name: apple-sync
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSync. Backend-agnostic sync protocol.

tiers.name: apple-syncgrdb
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSyncGRDB. The GRDB-backed sync implementation.

tiers.name: apple-semanticsearch
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSemanticSearch. Foundation-only semantic search: the TextEmbedder protocol, task prefixes, bundle manifest and stamp, vector maths over Accelerate, the half-float codec, the device chunker and result fusion.

tiers.name: apple-semanticsearchstore
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSemanticSearchStore. The ONNX Runtime embedder, the GRDB vector table, the FTS5 keyword index and SemanticSearchStore.

tiers.name: apple-markdown
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKMarkdown. The GRDB-backed markdown note store, built for macOS and iOS, re-exporting AgenticDeveloperHubSDK. Storage and sync only — no UI.

tiers.name: apple-integrations
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKIntegrations. Third-party service integrations (Gmail): models, store, client, sync.

tiers.name: apple-activity
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKActivity. Activity capture and tracking moved from Olylo: the usage-capture pipeline (FocusTracker, UsageCollector, UsageStore), context-event model, store and triggers, the capture permission gate, and usage sync. Built for macOS and iOS; macOS-only adapters and triggers are #if os(macOS)-gated.

tiers.name: apple-macos
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKMacOS. The feature-rich framework the host app, plugins, Whippet and Stenographer all consume.

tiers.name: apple-chromium
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKChromium. The Chrome Web Browser pane over the Chromium Embedded Framework: an Objective-C++ bridge (Bridge/, Private/) to CEF's C++ API, the BrowserEngine adapter and pane in Swift (Sources/), and the helper executable's source (Helper/, compiled by tools/apple/cef.py embed, not by the framework). CEF is pinned in Chromium/CEF.json.

tiers.name: apple-htdv
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHTDV. Native Hierarchical Topic Detail View: HTDVDataSource/HTDVController/HTDVLayoutEngine, form spec + FormState + FormViewController, MarkdownEditing protocol. Foundation + AppKit/UIKit only.

tiers.name: apple-hubauth
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHubAuth. The hub login on its own: SessionController, HubEnvironment and the transport sources, HubError, HubUser, HubAccount, the sign-in view model, passkeys and web sign-in, HubLinks. Links only AgenticDeveloperHubAuth, never the full client, HTDV or the workspace layer. AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHub re-exports it.

tiers.name: apple-hub
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHub. Shared hub feature layer: HubModules registry hook (re-exports AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHubAuth, which holds HubError), and per-feature models/data sources/modules consumed by the native hub apps.

tiers.name: apple-hubservice
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHubService. The hub's workspaces, API adapters and permissions — no UI. The session and transport live in AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHubAuth below it.

tiers.name: apple-hubui
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKHubUI. The hub's shells (AppKit and UIKit), sign-in, feature registry, and on macOS HubFeature and the hub script commands. Hosts assemble it; it builds no menu and no app delegate.

tiers.name: apple-systemmonitor
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSystemMonitor. Daemon-safe machine health: disk, memory, CPU and named process groups (Docker, Ollama), sampled on a timer. No AppKit.

tiers.name: apple-systemmonitorui
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKSystemMonitorUI. The themed System Status window and its reading cards and gauges.

tiers.name: apple-notifications
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKNotifications. Foundation only, macOS + iOS: the Notice model and its wire coding, the filter, routing rules and profiles, snooze math, flood folding and escalation policy. A daemon, a CLI and an iOS app can link it.

tiers.name: apple-notificationsui
tiers.holds: AgenticDeveloperHubSDKNotificationsUI. AppKit: the presentation center that routes notices to presenters, the non-activating NoticePanel, the themed card, the toast and alert presenters, screen selection and the snooze menu.

tiers.name: apple-tests
tiers.holds: Test bundles. Nothing depends on these.

tiers.name: apple-app
tiers.holds: The host app. Wiring only.

tiers.name: apple-plugins
tiers.holds: .aiplugin bundles plus AIPluginsShared.

tiers.name: web-toolchain
tiers.holds: The build and test toolchain every package's own `vitest.config.ts` and `tsup.config.ts` extends: the workspace-root presets, plus the two that happen to sit inside `features/` — a shared preset is toolchain wherever it physically lives, and longest-prefix matching is what lets those two files say so without moving. This is the one thing packages legitimately reach up to, so it is its own foundation tier rather than part of the `web-workspace` catch-all; otherwise every package in the repo reads as importing upward. Paths are spelled without extensions because a relative import resolves that way. Not shared: config to extend, not components to build on.

tiers.name: web-adh
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/adh. Family site chrome — header, footer, legal, themes, debug.

tiers.name: web-adh-api-types
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/adh-api-types. Generated vocabulary.

tiers.name: web-adh-next-config
tiers.holds: The `@adh-sdk/adh-next-config` package — a published sibling library other packages and every site build on. New code here is a change to the shared surface, so it stops for a decision.

tiers.name: web-adh-registry
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/adh-registry.

tiers.name: web-adh-site-config
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/adh-site-config.

tiers.name: web-adh-site-homes
tiers.holds: The `@adh-sdk/adh-site-homes` package — a published sibling library other packages and every site build on. New code here is a change to the shared surface, so it stops for a decision.

tiers.name: web-adh-ui
tiers.holds: The `@adh-sdk/adh-ui` package — a published sibling library other packages and every site build on. New code here is a change to the shared surface, so it stops for a decision.

tiers.name: web-api-explorer
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/api-explorer.

tiers.name: web-auth
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/auth. Session, sign-in surfaces, auth context.

tiers.name: web-controls
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/controls. filtered-list, panels, toggles, orb-row.

tiers.name: web-crud
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/crud. Generated CRUD surfaces.

tiers.name: web-data
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/data. Typed access over the backend API.

tiers.name: web-deploy-platform
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/deploy-platform.

tiers.name: web-features
tiers.holds: One package per product area. New feature code is expected here — but a piece that two features would both want belongs one tier down.

tiers.name: web-markdown
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/markdown.

tiers.name: web-messaging
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/messaging.

tiers.name: web-model
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/model. Providers, hooks, search/breadcrumb/nav lib.

tiers.name: web-next-env
tiers.holds: The `@adh-sdk/next-env` package — a published sibling library other packages and every site build on. New code here is a change to the shared surface, so it stops for a decision.

tiers.name: web-next-headers
tiers.holds: The `@adh-sdk/next-headers` package — a published sibling library other packages and every site build on. New code here is a change to the shared surface, so it stops for a decision.

tiers.name: web-next-preflight
tiers.holds: The `@adh-sdk/next-preflight` package — a published sibling library other packages and every site build on. New code here is a change to the shared surface, so it stops for a decision.

tiers.name: web-persona
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/persona.

tiers.name: web-resource
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/resource. List/detail scaffolding.

tiers.name: web-search
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/search.

tiers.name: web-themes
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/themes. ColorModeProvider, ThemeStyle, theme manifest.

tiers.name: web-ui
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/ui. shadcn slot, cn, blocks, globals.css. The bottom of the web stack.

tiers.name: web-analytics
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/analytics. Privacy-first product analytics any site can mount: the one PostHog config (anonymous, cookieless, allowlist-only), PostHogAnalytics to start it from a root layout, and the URL scrubbers every analytics and error pipeline shares. No adh imports, so a site outside the family drops it in.

tiers.name: web-avatar
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/avatar. Headless avatar behavior + animation engine. A persona-agnostic `useAvatarEngine` hook that gives any SVG face reflexes (blink, idle ladder, gaze, speech) and an expression-driven pose engine over optional channels (eyes, brows, antennae, mouth, body). Driven by an `expression` prop.

tiers.name: web-avatar-engine
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/avatar-engine.

tiers.name: web-chat
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/chat. React chat component library — InlineChat, ThreePaneChat, MobileChat, PersonaChat with pluggable backends.

tiers.name: web-chrome
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/chrome. Site-chrome primitives — the menu button and the close glyph derived from it, with the bar geometry in one place so every site rasterises them the same way.

tiers.name: web-editing
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/editing. The editing container: one owner of the draft, the Save button and the unsaved-changes guard for every editable surface.

tiers.name: web-landing
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/landing. Snap-scrolling long-form landing page kit — Deck, Screen, NavChrome and a block vocabulary, themed by CSS custom properties. HeroNav's sweep is web-textlens's lens.

tiers.name: web-site-template
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/site-template. The content-site frame every content site renders — a window-tall hero, the scrolling bands, the burger drawer and bitbag — built on the landing kit. A site supplies its copy and its custom slots, and nothing of the frame.

tiers.name: web-popover
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/popover. Hover popover with a pointing arrow — an anchored panel, the tail that points back at its trigger, the invisible bridge that lets the pointer cross the gap, and the one-open-at-a-time hover-intent state a row of them needs.

tiers.name: web-registry-profile
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/registry-profile. The public registry-entry profile renderer. Takes a serialized entry and renders it — no fetching, no auth, no adh imports, so it drops into anyone's site.

tiers.name: web-registry-types
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/registry-types. Framework-free registry field-type catalog: type ids, config shapes, validators and value coercion. No React, no runtime dependencies — the backend vendors this file so both sides validate owner-defined values against the same rules.

tiers.name: web-status-server
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/status-server. A status monitor's server: Hono app factory, monitor cycle, board, routes, OpenAPI, MCP, peers, telemetry, storage and the libSQL implementation. No React, no Next, no DOM — a backend host depends on this package alone.

tiers.name: web-status-web
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/status-web. A status monitor's operator dashboard: React panels, hooks and the browser-side API client. A Next host mounts these in its own pages, providers and proxy.

tiers.name: web-textlens
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/textlens. A travelling lens that sweeps along a line of text, magnifying, softening and tinting each glyph as it passes. Per-character DOM animation with the colour ramp read from CSS custom properties.

tiers.name: web-viewport
tiers.holds: @adh-sdk/viewport. Page-shell primitives for iOS-correct viewport + keyboard handling — ViewportShell, ViewportSpacer, ViewportComposer, useKeyboardInset, usePageScrollLock.

tiers.name: web-site
tiers.holds: The in-repo demo sites — websites/demo/, websites/site/ — and websites/run.sh. Outside the pnpm workspace; they consume the packages through file: refs, the way an external consumer would.

tiers.name: apple-project
tiers.holds: The Xcode/SwiftPM scaffolding around the frameworks: the workspace and xcodeproj, their shared schemes, project.yml, the Makefile, .swiftlint.yml and .swiftpm mirrors. Longest-prefix match sends every framework directory — including Language/ and Markdown/, which landed here for want of a tier until they got one — to its own tier, so only the build scaffolding lands here.

tiers.name: terminal-toolkit
tiers.holds: apt, the Python CLI for the Agentic Developer backend (pyproject.toml), built on a generated openapi-python-client client. Named terminal-toolkit, not terminal, to keep the tier name off any import specifier.

tiers.name: platform-stubs
tiers.holds: Placeholders for targets that do not exist yet — a .gitkeep under packages/android/ and packages/windows/ and nothing else. Named platform-stubs rather than android or windows because a tier name is matched against import specifiers.

tiers.name: web-workspace
tiers.holds: The pnpm workspace itself: package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, the lockfile, .npmrc/.npmignore, copy-css.mjs and the web README. Configuration for the packages below it, not code they import.

tiers.name: web-tools
tiers.holds: Python maintenance scripts run against the workspace by hand — content extraction and validation, and the chat-types copy verifier. They read the tree; nothing in the tree imports them.

tiers.name: repo-docs
tiers.holds: Design specs, plans, research and the project overview, including docs/web/ which holds the web stack's own layering table. Prose. Named repo-docs, not docs, to keep the tier name off any import specifier.

tiers.name: repo-meta
tiers.holds: How this repo is worked on rather than what it ships: the agent instructions, CI workflows, .gitignore, the top-level README, CONTRIBUTING and LICENSE, the install script and this tier map.

tiers.name: component-recipes
tiers.holds: The library cookbook — cookbook/cookbook.json plus one dated, versioned markdown spec per shared component (button, dialog, data-table, crud-table…), grouped by concept from general to specific and described without a platform in mind, each listing its code in a Reference Implementations table and its platform specifics in Platform Notes. Prose, and the human-readable index of what web-ui and its siblings already export: read it before proposing a new component.

tiers.name: component-specs
tiers.holds: One markdown spec per shared component and avatar-engine subsystem (accordion, avatar-engine-path, button…), describing behaviour the web and Apple implementations must agree on. Prose; read it before changing a component it covers.

tiers.name: repo-tools
tiers.holds: Repo-level guards and maintenance scripts, run by hand and in CI; nothing imports them. check_boundaries.py enforces this repo's OTHER layering rule, orthogonal to the tiers here: packages named @adh-sdk/adh* are the adh VOCABULARY tier and portable MECHANISM packages may never import them, with the banned set discovered from package.json names, never listed. Alongside it: the doc-link, doc-subpath, private-scope, recipe-scope and site-deps checks, the recipe classifier, and apple/ (release and framework-embedding helpers).
